Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree. Experience with Linux and Windows server software. Experience building, deploying, and troubleshooting large-scale compute systems. Familiarity with resource development and management (Kubernetes, Docker).
